# Support

This is a system design exercise monorepo — not a supported product.

- **Questions about a specific service?** Each service has its own README with design decisions.
- **Found a bug?** Open an [issue](https://github.com/faisalaffan/faisalaffan-design-system/issues).
- **Want to learn system design?** Start with [README.md](../README.md) for architecture overview.

References:
- Alex Xu — *System Design Interview* (2nd Ed)
- Martin Kleppmann — *Designing Data-Intensive Applications*
